intro.title: Dispensing Schedule H Medicines
intro.subtitle: Prescription mandate, doctor registration validation, and automatic statutory register logging

narration.text: Welcome to Phase 3, Part 1: Dispensing Schedule H Prescription Medicines. Under the Drugs and Cosmetics Rules, dispensing Schedule H formulations without a registered medical practitioner's prescription is strictly prohibited.
When you search and add a Schedule H drug like Amoxicillin 500mg into the billing cart, MediFlow immediately tags the item with a red Rx badge and flags statutory controlled dispensing.
The Doctor and Prescription panel unfolds automatically. Select the prescriber from your registered doctor directory to automatically pull their name and Medical Council registration number.
Enter the patient's prescription serial number and prescription date. MediFlow ensures all required regulatory fields are satisfied before enabling counter settlement.
The completed invoice is automatically indexed in your statutory Schedule H register for inspection audits. In Part 2, discover strict Schedule H1 and Schedule X Narcotics compliance.

outro.takeaway: Schedule H Dispensing: Enforce mandatory doctor registration and prescription tracking seamlessly at POS, preventing audit fines and regulatory penalties.
